events.details: Initial orchestration omitted the explicit batch-authorization record flag. All affected run_000 states show awaiting_user_authorization and zero model requests; originals preserved, rerun uses a new run directory.

Authorization preflight was initially restricted to task9; the user authorized the formal batch, so the scope check now accepts every task on the frozen 100x100 R4 map. Original run directories preserved; retry uses a new run directory, no model request replay.

account_usage_guard.limitation: Weekly usage is integer-rounded and may update with delay; no account spend or actual billing is inferred.

request_budget_allocation: reserve each pending task shortest-path lower bound; distribute any additional authorized requests evenly across remaining tasks; maximum 512 requests per task continuation
retry_policy: zero_retries; interrupted in-flight outcome is unknown and never automatically replayed
session_policy: one isolated Codex CLI request per route action; each prompt repeats the compact map, current route state, feature context, and v3 cost-to-go guidance
status_policy: invalid task actions are not executed; task outcome is audited before the next independent task

usage_guard.mechanism: caller supplies a fresh account snapshot before each invocation; this process can pause after a bounded number of requests but cannot query account usage MCP itself

validation_policy: local deterministic validator gates each movement; no traditional route fallback
